detail.tone: No bounce from the morning low yet. The fall is concentrated in one sector rather than a panic across the board.
watch: IRDAI signalling the caps could be softened
Crude slipping back below $100 on an Iran headline
US yields cooling in the evening session

top.title: IRDAI commission caps hit insurers, NBFCs
top.line: PB Fintech −23% · L&T Fin −7.5% · HDFC Life −7% · Bajaj Fin −4%
more: Draft caps: credit life 2% (from 28%), health 5% (from 40%), motor OD 5% (from 16%), loan-linked motor TP 0%
Also bans forced bundling of insurance with loans and volume-linked incentives
SBI Life, ICICI Pru Life down up to 10%; MMFSL −2.6%
IIFL sees 1–12% EPS hit for NBFCs (L&T Finance worst); Bernstein, Emkay flag PB Fintech's model

src.title: Business Today — PB Fintech, NBFCs fall

top.title: US 10-yr yield hits 5.11%, highest since 2007
top.line: Bond selloff and hawkish Fed talk pull money from emerging markets
more: 10-yr jumped 15 bp in a day, the biggest move since the 2025 tariff shock
Fed Governor Barr's remarks raised bets on more rate hikes
Wall St overnight: Dow −0.7%, S&P −0.75%, Nasdaq −1.1%
Asia mixed: Nikkei +1.5%, Kospi +0.9%, Hang Seng −0.7%

top.title: NSE lists flat, then climbs ~4–5%
more: Trading around ₹1,860; market cap about ₹4.6 lakh cr
QIB portion subscribed 12.68×; 34 lakh+ retail investors got allotment
India's second-largest IPO after Hyundai Motor India (2024)
Firm debut despite a weak market: a sign of institutional appetite

top.title: Brent back above $100, near $102.5
top.line: Up 4% yesterday as US–Iran talks turn uncertain
more: Oil above $100 pressures the rupee and India's import bill
OMCs, paints, aviation and chemicals are most exposed
Any Iran deal headline can swing crude sharply either way

summary: Selling has deepened rather than faded: the Nifty is down about 1% and pressure is concentrated in lenders and insurers, while defensives are holding.
